g.text: A shared candidate support for every coordinate projection
For each block r, coordinate l,
Stable sorting; focal training row excluded by
Deduplicate the union over blocks and heads
Keep aligned reference IDs; mask padding
Gather xⱼ, uⱼ, yⱼ on the same IDs
All coordinate Q/K/V branches share Cᵢ
ONE softmax per query and head over Cᵢ
R = H = 1: |Cᵢ| ≤ K. General case: |Cᵢ| ≤ min(Neligible, RHK).
Reference tokens remain fixed across attention blocks; only the query state is updated.
